question: Which of the following metals forms a green colour coating due to corrosion?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Copper (Cu) is the metal that forms a green coating due to corrosion when exposed to air.**
 
• This happens **because copper reacts with moisture** and gases in the air,
 
• It f**orms a mixture of copper carbonate and copper hydroxide.** 
 
• To clean tarnished copper vessels, you can use lemon or tamarind juice to restore their characteristic lustre

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Corrosion**

 
 
• **Metals when kept open react with oxygen and moisture present in the air. **
 
• This process is called corrosion.
 
• The **metal undercover chemically reacts with the oxygen in the atmosphere and forms an oxide on the surface of the metal.**
 
• Rust formation over Iron when it is kept in presence of moist air is an example of corrosion.
 
• It leads to loss of strength and shine of metal.
